question: Paano kinukwenta ang zoning fee at filing fee para sa Locational Clearance ng 2-storey building sa CPDO?
answer:
Ang zoning fee at filing fee para sa Locational Clearance ng 2-storey building sa CPDO ay hindi nakalaman sa mga nabigyan naming source blocks. Ang mga source blocks lamang ay tungkol sa issuance at validation ng Locational Clearance, hindi pa nakalaman ang mga fee na ito.

Para sa mga impormasyon tungkol sa mga fee, maaari kang pakiusap sa City Planning CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-3.pdf o sa ibang mga available na dokumento ng CPDO.

[S1, S3] (City Planning CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-3.pdf | printed page 648, 699)

ground_truth:
For Locational Clearance for Building Permit for 2-storey and below, the zoning fee is 1/10 of 1% of building cost for agricultural/residential and commercial/industrial/institutional categories. Filing fees are PHP150 per application for agricultural/residential and PHP300 per application for commercial/industrial.

The Map Plotting step separately lists a PHP300 filing fee, with order of payment issued by OBO. The TOTAL row lists 4 Days, 2 Hours, and 25 Minutes. The source does not explicitly list an institutional filing fee or explain aggregation of the map-plotting charge in the TOTAL row.
